issues.on_page: General Government: Water Fund 30,508.57, Sewer Fund 24,040.91
issues.issue: The Water and Sewer Fund spending is printed on line 29 'General Government', and the business-type lines 45-48 are blank. Calling it utilities follows from the fund columns and is defensible, but the category doesn't match the printed label. The same applies to detail[15] and detail[17].
